inputs.text: Full-length figure from head to feet: Kumbhakarna, a colossal rakshasa giant standing heavily with bent knees, a huge round belly and massive shoulders, a broad brutish leonine face with heavy-lidded sleepy eyes, short white tusks and a wild dark-gold mane. Warm golden-yellow skin everywhere, ornate bronze shoulder armour, bronze armbands, a round bronze belt plate and a brown loincloth. His right hand grips upright at his side a huge war club: a thick dark wooden club bound with iron bands and studded with blunt iron knobs, its heavy rounded head rising above his shoulder. Two arms. Golden-yellow ochre and bronze. Bold hand-painted 2D action-game character art with confident dark ink outlines, rich painterly detail, a strong readable silhouette and chunky heroic proportions, three-quarter top-down game sprite view, in the spirit of classical Indian temple murals. The entire figure is visible from head to feet, standing on the ground, centered, alone before a flat, even, medium-grey backdrop filling the whole image.
